recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-era pastoral scene featuring a couple on a vintage bicycle, set against a soft-focus grassy field. The composition is anchored by a large, ornate Victorian-style oval frame on the left containing stylized, heavy-weight typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The ornate gold frame balances the vertical weight of the couple on the bicycle.
The muted green of the grass serves as a monochromatic backdrop for the white dress.
The heavy, blocky typography contrasts with the delicate filigree of the frame.
coreInvariants: Muted, desaturated color palette with olive and sage greens.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Couple on bicycle positioned right of center, occupying the full vertical height; text frame positioned left of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large green oval frame with gold filigree.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the heavy display text in the frame, moves right to the couple's faces, then follows the bicycle down to the grass.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus grassy field in the foreground and background provides breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage and olive greens (background and frame fill).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-to-high value with a slightly yellowed, aged tint.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep browns or dark greens for shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and psychedelic display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with minimal counters.
Slightly flared terminals and rounded corners on display text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'M' and 'A' feature exaggerated, blocky proportions to fill space.
Terminals are often squared off or slightly curved to match the frame's interior.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face for the artist name paired with a lighter, condensed sans-serif for track listings.
graphicDevices: Thin-line rectangular border for secondary metadata

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded 60s display feel.
Matches the ornate scrollwork of the frame.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, grainy 1960s film photograph of a couple on a vintage bicycle in a grassy field. The woman wears a long white dress; the man wears a tan coat and dark hat. Muted olive green tones throughout.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large olive-green oval on the left side, bordered by intricate gold Victorian scrollwork. Inside the oval, center-align heavy, blocky dark-green display text with very tight leading.

verificationChecks: Is the typography sufficiently heavy and tightly packed?
Does the image have a desaturated, vintage film grain?
Is the white dress the brightest point of the composition?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is contained within the oval frame.
Check that the grain texture is consistent across the image.
Verify the gold frame color is muted, not metallic or shiny.
Confirm the bicycle style is period-accurate (thin tires, vintage frame).
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a pastoral film-style photograph with a left-aligned ornate graphic container and heavy, stacked display typography in a monochromatic green palette.
